app.name: Nirmay
app.tagline: AI-Assisted Oral Cancer Screening & Triage Platform
app.disclaimer: Screening aid, not diagnosis. Always consult a qualified medical professional for definitive diagnosis.

emergency.banner_message: Heavy bleeding, inability to swallow, or airway blockage requires emergency care.
emergency.default_message: Severe bleeding, choking, or inability to swallow requires immediate emergency care.

landing.hero_title: Early Oral Cancer Screening & Clinical Handoff
landing.hero_desc: Nirmay connects community health camps, rural clinics, and patients with oncology specialists through rules-based risk triage, oral photo quality screening, and structured clinician review.
landing.how_it_works_desc: Designed for transparency: every assessment cites contributing factors and requires human clinician review.
landing.step1_desc: Informed consent in your language, followed by a 2-minute lifestyle and tobacco exposure assessment.
landing.step1_checks: Key Checks: Tobacco (smoking & smokeless), betel quid, duration, and personal history.
landing.step2_desc: Tracks ulcer duration (an ulcer > 3 weeks is a key signal) and checks immediate emergency red flags.
landing.step2_checks: Emergency Rule: Severe bleeding or swallowing failure triggers immediate hospital escalation.
landing.step3_desc: Checks blur, brightness, and mouth framing before running image screening with Grad-CAM focus overlay.
landing.step3_checks: Safe Fallback: Blurry photos are politely refused with practical retake guidance.
landing.step4_desc: Flagged cases land in the doctor queue with a structured handoff bundle, reasons list, and video consult.
landing.step4_checks: Doctor In Control: Clinician confirms or overrides with a documented clinical reason.
landing.workspaces_desc: Access role-specific interfaces tailored for field health workers, patients, and clinical teams.
landing.ws_patient_desc: Perform guided self-assessment, check lesion symptoms, upload photos, learn mouth self-exams, and track tobacco quitting.
landing.ws_hw_desc: Screen rural camp participants rapidly, assist with consent and intake, generate QR health cards, and route high-risk cases.
landing.ws_doctor_desc: Review triage queues ordered by urgency and wait time, inspect Grad-CAM heatmaps, record clinical reviews, and host video calls.
landing.model_card_desc: We believe in full algorithmic transparency. Review our model card covering intended scope, dataset representation, lighting/skin-tone limitations, and honest placeholder disclosures.

patient.dashboard_desc: Perform guided self-assessment, capture oral lesion photos, and review your triage handoff.
patient.intake_card_desc: Answer brief questions regarding tobacco habits, betel quid use, alcohol exposure, and family history.
patient.symptoms_card_desc: Check for non-healing ulcers (>3 weeks), lumps, white/red patches, pain, or difficulty swallowing.
patient.photo_card_desc: Upload a clear, well-lit photo of your oral lesion to run quality-gate checks and screening analysis.

patient.quit_card_desc: Set your quit date, track smoke-free/gutkha-free days, monitor money saved, and manage cravings.

phrases.Smokeless tobacco (gutkha, khaini, zarda: Smokeless tobacco (gutkha, khaini, zarda) and paan are safer than smoking cigarettes.
phrases.In India and South Asia, smokeless tobac: In India and South Asia, smokeless tobacco and areca nut (supari) are the leading cause of oral squamous cell carcinoma (SCC). Betel quid with tobacco exposes oral mucosa directly to potent carcinogens (tobacco-specific nitrosamines), drastically elevating oral cavity cancer risk.
phrases.If a mouth ulcer or red sore does not hu: If a mouth ulcer or red sore does not hurt, it cannot be serious.
phrases.Early oral cancers are often completely: Early oral cancers are often completely painless. Many patients delay seeking care because the lesion doesn't cause severe pain initially. Any oral sore, ulcer, or red patch that persists for more than 3 weeks without healing must be evaluated by a healthcare professional.
phrases.Taking a tissue biopsy will make the can: Taking a tissue biopsy will make the cancer spread or worsen.
phrases.A biopsy does not spread cancer. A small: A biopsy does not spread cancer. A small tissue biopsy examined by a pathologist is the single definitive gold standard required to determine if a lesion is benign, precancerous, or malignant, allowing timely cure while lesions are small.
phrases.White or red patches in the mouth will d: White or red patches in the mouth will disappear on their own.
phrases.White patches (leukoplakia) and velvety: White patches (leukoplakia) and velvety red patches (erythroplakia) are well-recognized potentially malignant disorders (OPMD). Red patches in particular carry a high rate of dysplasia. They must be professionally examined and biopsied if persistent.
phrases.Oral cancer only affects elderly individ: Oral cancer only affects elderly individuals.
phrases.While risk rises with age, habit initiat: While risk rises with age, habit initiation with flavoured areca nut, pan masala, and gutkha at young ages has caused a marked surge in oral precancers and submucous fibrosis (OSMF) among young adults aged 18 to 35.
phrases.Look into a mirror with good light. Pull: Look into a mirror with good light. Pull your lower lip down and inspect the inside pink tissue. Repeat with the upper lip. Check gums around both upper and lower teeth.
phrases.Use clean fingers to gently stretch the: Use clean fingers to gently stretch the right cheek outward. Inspect the lining from the back molars to the corner of the lips. Repeat on the left side.
phrases.Stick your tongue out and check the top: Stick your tongue out and check the top surface. Hold the tip of your tongue with a clean gauze/cloth and gently move it to the right and left to inspect both lateral edges. Lift your tongue up to inspect the floor of the mouth.
phrases.Tilt your head back, open wide, and insp: Tilt your head back, open wide, and inspect the roof of your mouth for colour changes, ulcers, or swelling.
phrases.Feel both sides of your neck and underne: Feel both sides of your neck and underneath your lower jaw with your fingers. Check for any firm, enlarged, or painless lumps.
phrases.Persistent ulcers, white patches, firm n: Persistent ulcers, white patches, firm nodules, or unexplained bleeding.
